scriptsInfo.fire-tv:dev: Build, install, and launch Threshold on a named Fire TV. Run without arguments for an interactive device selector, or pass monitor, bedroom, or guest.

scriptsInfo.fire-tv:launch:all: Launch Threshold on every connected authorized ADB device without rebuilding.
